1.label: very_easy
1.summary: One receiver and a responsive motor isolate sustained tracking; visibly changing speed prevents a fixed-rate solution.

natural_language_by_interaction.full: Probe the opaque cabinet ports: H is absorbed, R returns to entry, paired numbers identify an exit. Patch each colored lamp to a port that reaches its numbered receiver. Start the optical run and steer every mirror so its beam remains inside the moving receiver. Charge leaks quickly when light misses; a full red heat bar ends the attempt. All receivers must be fully charged together to unlock the seal key. Stored charge then stays stable, but the receivers keep moving. Insert the whole seal key inside AMBER's moving opening; a miss ends the attempt. Routing probes before START are safe. There is no in-game stop, reset or retry. Drag each lamp socket onto a cabinet port; drag the round trim handles. When charged, drag the seal key from the cabinet into AMBER's opening.
